description.blurb: Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 was captured by the gravity of Jupiter, torn apart and then crashed into the giant planet in July 1994.
description.more: NASA's Galileo orbiter (then still en route to Jupiter) captured unprecedented direct views as the string of fragments labeled A through W smashed into Jupiter's cloud tops. The impacts started on 16 July 1994 and ended on 22 July 1994.
